title: Triples-to-aux conversion distributes over concatenation
statement: Fix a width $w \in \bbn$, and let $\Phi$ denote the triples-to-aux conversion, which turns a finite list of triples in $\mathrm{Fin}(w) \times \mathrm{Bool} \times \mathrm{Bool}$ into an aux list of $(\bbn \times \mathrm{Bool})$ entries. Then $\Phi$ carries concatenation to concatenation: for any two such lists $T_1$ and $T_2$, \[ \Phi(T_1 \mathbin{+\!\!+} T_2) = \Phi(T_1) \mathbin{+\!\!+} \Phi(T_2). \]
hypotheses_covered: two lists $T_1, T_2$ of triples in $\mathrm{Fin}(w) \times \mathrm{Bool} \times \mathrm{Bool}$
